item.title: All 7 hospitalized victims now have non-life-threatening injuries after Shockoe Bottom mass shooting
item.description: The woman who was in critical condition following a mass shooting in Shockoe Bottom on Saturday, Feb. 21, now has non-life threatening injuries. Seven people were taken to the hospital with gunshot wounds are all expected to survive.

item.title: Commercial kitchen fire breaks out at Williamsburg strip mall
item.description: A commercial kitchen fire broke out at a strip mall in Williamsburg on Monday morning.

item.title: PHOTOS: Megan Moroney celebrates new album with Richmond-area fans
item.description: Country singer Megan Moroney spent some quality time with Richmond-area fans at the National on Saturday, joining them in celebrating her newest album.

item.title: 'Tonight, we celebrate': Richmond leaders patch funding gap for Affordable Housing Trust Fund
item.description: Richmond leaders passed a measure Monday night that they say will better guarantee that affordable housing initiatives throughout the city are consistently funded, patching holes they recently discovered in existing law.

item.title: Virginia ABC rejects proposal to extend state's happy hour law
item.description: The Virginia ABC has confirmed with 8News that it will not be extending the commonwealth's happy hour duration, despite a request from the Virginia Restaurant, Lodging and Travel Association.

item.title: 'Tracking everybody, everywhere': Richmonders rally against Flock license plate readers
item.description: Flock camera surveillance technology used by the Richmond Police Department to help solve crimes is at the center of controversy, as demonstrators rallied against them Monday night.

item.title: CarMax settles with DOJ over illegal repossessions of dozens of servicemembers' cars
item.description: Central Virginia-based CarMax, Inc. will pay out nearly $500,000 to resolve allegations that it illegally repossessed dozens of vehicles owned by military service members.

item.title: Three arrested after 18-year-old injured in Buffalo Wild Wings shooting in Mechanicsville
item.description: Three people are facing charges three months after an 18-year-old was injured in a shooting at a Buffalo Wild Wings location in Hanover County's Mechanicsville area.

item.title: 'Really horrific': Richmond mayor, police chief discuss next steps after Shockoe Bottom mass shooting
item.description: Richmond Mayor Danny Avula and Richmond Police Chief Rick Edwards continue to speak out on the weekend Shockoe Bottom mass shooting, calling it a needless tragedy.

item.title: 'We are devastated': Family speaks after 23-year-old Hope Cartwright killed in hit-and-run
item.description: Days after the death of Virginia Living editor Hope Cartwright following a hit-and-run in Richmond, her family is speaking publicly for the first time.
